audience: HR teams in Turkey that manage leave, time records and employee data in Kolay IK

useCases.title: Check who is on leave
useCases.text: List leave records by status or date range, and open one to see its type, dates and replacement person.

useCases.title: Read leave balances for an employee
useCases.text: Find an employee by name, then read the earned, used, carried over and unused leave days per leave type.

useCases.title: Review time records waiting for approval
useCases.text: List time records by person, status and date range, and open one to see its minutes and type.

useCases.title: Record leave for an employee
useCases.text: Check the leave balance of the employee, then record the leave. The record may be approved at once, and it deducts the used days.

useCases.title: Add a company calendar event
useCases.text: Check the calendar for a date range, then add a meeting or holiday event that employees can see.

useCases.title: Update an employee's basic data
useCases.text: Read an employee's profile, then change the basic data you pass. The HR record changes at once.
